Get to know me

About Me

A Master Track student in Information Systems at Bina Nusantara University, possessing strong analytical skills in database design, systems analysis, and requirements analysis.

Experienced in building and managing databases using phpMyAdmin, Oracle, and SQL Server Management Studio, as well as designing Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERDs) for websites and applications using Draw.io and Power Pivot to support efficient data-driven system development.

Experienced in application and website prototyping in Figma, and web development using PHP, JavaScript, and CSS with XAMPP-based databases. Adaptable under pressure and committed to developing into a Systems Analyst.
